system.domain: Diabetes clinical guidance (5 official .gov sources: CDC, CMS, FDA, USPSTF, NIDDK)
system.stack: LlamaIndex + Chroma + BGE-base embeddings (local) + gpt-4o-mini + DeepEval + Presidio

eval.metrics: Faithfulness + Answer Relevancy (DeepEval) + custom Correctness (GEval) + deterministic safety/routing/refusal

hipaa.components: Presidio PHI detection (+ custom SSN recognizer) + rule-based clinical-boundary checker, fused in a custom DeepEval HIPAAComplianceMetric

experiments.name: Chunk size 512 -> 256
experiments.result: Tradeoff: fixed a retrieval miss (TC004) but regressed faithfulness on another case. Not adopted.

experiments.name: Embedding model MiniLM -> BGE-base
experiments.result: Clean win: target chunk rank >20 -> 4 at chunk_size 512; TC004 relevancy 0.0 -> 1.0, no regression. ADOPTED.

experiments.name: FDA PDF re-extraction (PyMuPDF, column-aware)
experiments.result: Fixed garbled two-column label; TC021 went from 'I don't have that info' to a correct answer. Exposed 2 eval-harness flaws (verbosity penalty, rigid expected outputs).
